 Check Your Ladder Before Hanging Holiday Lights. 3.6 Million Little Giant Ladders Were Just Recalled
 Devin Marchetti 
 Published Nov 14, 2026 
 Before you pull out the ladder to hang holiday lights this weekend, check the brand. Little Giant just recalled 3.6 million ladders , and a raw cheddar sold in New Jersey, a popular tabletop fire pit and a Target air fryer oven are on this week’s federal recall lists too.
 Product 
 How many 
 Sold at 
 What to do 
 Little Giant ladders with Rapid Locks 
 3.66 million 
 Lowe’s, Costco, Amazon 
 Free repair kit 
 Bose S1 Pro speaker batteries 
 634,759 
 Bose, Best Buy, Amazon 
 Free new battery 
 Sharper Image tabletop fire pits 
 265,000 
 Target, Walmart, Home Depot and more

 175,951 
 Target 
 Free repair kit 
 Family Farmstead raw cheddar 
 All dated through 10/16/27 
 Stores in NJ, PA, DE and 9 more states 
 Return it 
 Which Little Giant Ladders Are Recalled?
 Little Giant ladders with Rapid Locks , the black or orange locks on each leg used to change the height. The ladder can suddenly drop if a lock is not fully engaged, the Consumer Product Safety Commission said.
 The recalled models are the Adjustable Fortress 2.0, Conquest 2.0, Dark Horse 2.0, Epic, King Kombo XT, Leveler, MegaLite, MegaLite+, Multi, Quantum and Vector. The model name is on the side of the ladder.
 Look for an orange rectangular “QC” sticker on the rail above one of the locks. If your ladder has it, it is not part of the recall.
 The Rapid Locks are the black or orange locks on each leg. (CPSC) 
 The company has 25 reports of ladders dropping, with 19 people hurt. Three had head injuries, with reports such as a skull fracture and a traumatic brain injury. The ladders were sold from December 2015 through October 2026 for about $100 to $1,000.
 Stop using it until you read the instructions at littlegiantladders.com/pages/recalls and order the free kit of warning labels, or call 866-201-9069.
 Which Cheddar Cheese Is Recalled in New Jersey?
 All raw mild and raw sharp cheddar from Family Farmstead Dairy of Worcester, New York, in 8-ounce plastic-wrapped packs dated 10/16/27 or earlier. It may carry Listeria, the company said in a notice posted by the FDA .
 The cheese went to stores in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware and nine other states. Listeria is most dangerous for pregnant women, older people and young children. Take it back to the store, or call the dairy at 607-397-4044.
 This is the farm’s second cheddar recall in a month, after an E. coli recall on Oct. 15.
 Which Sharper Image Fire Pits Are Recalled?
 About 265,000 Sharper Image tabletop fire pits and tabletop Infinity fire pits, the small kind you fill with liquid fuel. Burning fuel can escape or flame can shoot out of the fuel container, and four people suffered burns, some third and fourth degree, the CPSC said .
 The recalled Infinity version, with a steel base and glass sides. (CPSC) 
 The round concrete version has a “77” logo on the front, and the Infinity one has a steel base with glass sides. They sold for $30 to $50 at Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Lowe’s, Kohl’s, TJ Maxx, Marshalls and other stores from January 2023 to June 2026.
 Stop using it. You get a full refund by registering at firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com, or call 855-215-5032.
 Is the Bose S1 Pro Battery Recalled?
 Yes, about 635,000 battery packs for the Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ portable Bluetooth speakers. They can overheat and catch fire, and Bose has seven reports of packs melting, smoking or burning, the CPSC said .
 A recalled S1 Pro battery pack. (CPSC) 
 Check the serial number on the bottom of the battery. It is recalled if it starts with 083723, 078352, 084105, 078591, 078592, 084106 or 086409. Take the battery out and you can keep using the speaker plugged in. Bose sends a free replacement through support.bose.com/s1-battery-recall .
 Which Gourmia Air Fryer Is Recalled?
 The Gourmia 9-Slice Digital Air Fryer Oven, model GTF7530, sold only at Target for about $150. Its glass doors can snap shut when bumped while you reach for hot food, and 40 people burned their hands or wrists, the CPSC said .
 Check the label on the back for model GTF7530. (CPSC) 
 With Thanksgiving cooking coming up, stop using it and get the free doorstop kit at gourmia.com/recall.asp or by calling 888-834-0092.
 What Baby and Kids Products Were Recalled This Week?
 Four more recalls are worth a look for families with small children, all from the CPSC.
 Baby Brezza SuperFast Sterilizer Dryer , models BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156. About 29,000 can overheat and melt. Sold at TJ Maxx, Marshalls and Target.com. Free replacement.
 X-VESOLJE nursing pillows from Amazon. About 19,600 can block a baby’s breathing. Full refund.
 Arlopu slide playsets , models KT-CS17 and LY-31, from Amazon and Walmart. A child’s head can get trapped. Free repair kit.
 Magnetopia magnetic building cubes from Magnetopia.com. Loose magnets can be swallowed. Full refund.
 You can check anything else you own on the CPSC’s recall list .
